description: This file defines a final class 'CallableResolver' in the Slim framework, responsible for resolving callables, routes, and middleware references, potentially using a container for dependency injection. It handles various formats for resolving callables, including string notation and array representations, and ensures callables are resolvable and properly bound to containers.

classes.name: CallableResolver
classes.description: A final class in the Slim framework that resolves various forms of callables, including those specified by strings, arrays, or objects, using optional dependency injection container, ensuring proper resolution and binding for route and middleware handling.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a given identifier into a callable, handling various formats and resolving slim notation. Uses container binding if applicable.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route handler, applying default 'handle' method if necessary, using the resolveByPredicate helper.

methods.name: resolveMiddleware
methods.description: Resolves middleware components, applying default 'process' method if applicable, via resolveByPredicate.

methods.name: resolveByPredicate
methods.description: Generic resolver that applies a predicate to determine if the input should be treated as a class or method, resolving accordingly.

methods.name: isRoute
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is an instance of RequestHandlerInterface.

methods.name: isMiddleware
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is an instance of MiddlewareInterface.

methods.name: resolveSlimNotation
methods.description: Resolves string notation of the form 'Class:method' to an object and method, using container if available, or instantiating classes dynamically.

methods.name: assertCallable
methods.description: Validates that a resolved value is actually callable, throwing exceptions if not.

methods.name: bindToContainer
methods.description: Binds a Closure to the container if applicable, enabling dependency injection.

methods.name: prepareToResolve
methods.description: Prepares array or string inputs into a standardized format for resolution.
